blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Neural audio codecs (NACs) have become a fundamental infrastructure for modern speech-language models, discretizing continuous speech signals into token sequences that enable large language models to process and generate audio. Most research evaluates codec quality at the decoding phase, assessing the naturalness of reconstructed speech. However, little research investigates what phonetic information is captured during encoding. In this paper, we investigated the potential correlates of prosody in the NAC Mimi, a codec used by conversational speech agents such as Moshi and Sesame and used in downstream tasks such as speech-to-speech translation (Hibiki).
blocks.zh: 神经音频编解码器(NACs)已经成为了现代语音-语言模型的基本基础设施,将连续的语音信号磁盘化为符号序列,使大型语言模型能够处理并生成音频. 大多数研究评价了解码阶段的编码质量,评估了重建后语音的自然性. 然而,很少有研究调查在编码过程中捕获到什么口音信息. 在本文中,我们调查了NAC Mimi中prosody的潜在关联性,这是Moshi和Sesame等对话语音代理使用并用于语音对语音翻译(Hibiki)等下游任务的编码.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Neural audio codecs (NACs) have become central in the design of modern speech models, enabling efficient audio tokenization. These models use neural networks to compress speech into discrete code sequences for high-quality reconstruction at low bitrates [ 1 ] . Many codecs have been developed for industry needs, especially in conversational agents and specific applications. For instance, NotebookLM is an application from Google that leverages the Soundstream codec to produce podcasts [ 2 ] . We can also cite Google Research’s AudioLM model [ 3 ] , an audio generation model, that employs SoundStream’s discrete representations as targets during its training process. In comparison, Meta Research’s VALL‑E utilizes the Encodec codec [ 4 ] as an intermediate feature for text‑to‑speech tasks. Neural models such as Vall-E [ 5 ] have been used as language modeling tools for tasks like text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis and speech-to-speech neural translation. Vall-E’s architecture demonstrates the potential of neural vocoders for accurate voice synthesis by efficiently encoding speaker identity, prosody, and linguistic content into compressed representations. Finally, [ 6 ] introduced VALL-E X, a cross-lingual neural codec language model specifically designed for multilingual speech synthesis. VALL-E X leverages large-scale training data to facilitate cross-lingual transfer, enabling high-quality speech generation across languages with minimal speaker-specific data.
blocks.zh: 神经音频编码器(NACs)已经成为现代语音模型设计的核心,能够高效的音频符号化. 这些模型使用神经网络将语音压缩成离散代码序列,用于低比特率的高质量重建[1]. 许多解码器是为行业需要而开发的,特别是在对话代理人和具体应用方面. 例如,NotebookLM是一个来自Google的应用程序,它利用Soundstream编码器来生产播客[2]. 我们也可以引用Google Research的AudioLM模型[3], 一种音频生成模型, 相比之下,Meta Research的VALL‐E将Encodec codec [4] 用作文本的中间功能。 Vall-E[5]等神经模型被用作文本对语音(TTS)合成和语音对语音神经翻译等任务的语言模型工具. Vall-E的架构通过高效编码扬声器身份,prosody,以及语言内容进入压缩表达,展示了神经vocodes准确语音合成的潜力. 最后,[6]引入了VALL-E X,这是一种跨语言的神经编码语言模型,专门为多语言语音合成而设计. VALL-E X利用大规模培训数据,促进跨语言的传输,使高质量的语音生成能够跨语言生成,并且能提供最低限度的发言者专用数据。

blocks.en: In this paper, we focus on Mimi, a codec designed for the conversational agent Moshi [ 1 ] , also used by the conversational agent Sesame AI 1 1 1 https://www.ai-sesame.com/ and the speech-to-speech translation system Hibiki [ 7 ] . The NAC Mimi uses Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ) to generate hierarchical discrete speech representations [ 8 ] . RVQ not only compresses phonetic information, but may also distill semantic and suprasegmental speech features. In the encoding phase, Mimi is reported to encode the semantic representation of speech in the first codebook, using distillation from WaveLM. The other codebooks are specialized for “acoustic representations” [ 1 ] . These range from codebook_0 to codebook_7, in a process referred to as semantic “distillation”. We aim to discuss this division of labour between the first codebook specialized in segmental representation and the seven other codebooks, apparently the most likely to capture prosodic variability. Our paper aims to verify this, testing the correlations between the 2048 tokens used in the 8 codebooks [ 1 ] with phone posteriorgram predictions and three prosodic features that we have systematically modified using the WinPitch software [ 9 ] . The features we chose to modify incrementally are duration, pitch, and glissando values. Duration and pitch are core dimensions of prosodic structure, while the glissando threshold was used as a way to triangulate pitch value and duration.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们关注Mimi,这是为对话代理Moshi[1]设计的编码器,也被对话代理Sesame AI 1 1 1使用 https://www.ai-seme.com/和语音对speech翻译系统Hibiki[來源請求]. 7] (中文(简体) ). NAC Mimi使用残留矢量量化(RVQ)生成分级离散的语音表达[8]. RVQ不仅压缩语音信息,还可能提炼语义和超格语音特征. 在编码阶段,据报道米米在第一个编码本中将语音的语义表示编码,使用来自WaveLM的蒸馏. 其他编码簿是专用于“音响表达”[1]。 其范围从代码簿_0到代码簿_7,在一个被称为语义“distillation”的过程中。 我们的目的是讨论第一本专门处理分部代表性问题的法典与其他七本法典之间的分工,这显然最有可能反映偏差。 我们的论文旨在验证这一点,测试8个编码本[1]中使用的2048个令牌与电话后图预测和我们使用WinPitch软件系统修改的三个正则特性之间的关联性[9]. 我们选择逐渐修改的特征是持续时间,投球和格利桑多值. 周期和投球是Prosotic结构的核心维度,而格利桑多阈值被用作三角化投球值和持续时间的一种方法.

blocks.en: Most codec studies focus on decoding quality, with limited research on encoding behavior or codebook properties. Little research has been carried out on the encoding side, especially when trying to find correlates in the codec codebooks when investigating the properties of the speech tokenizer codebook. Others [ 10 ] , [ 11 ] use the posteriorgram method to try to find correspondence between the probability of detecting a phone and the codebook. To the best of our knowledge, no systematic investigation has been carried out in the prosodic domain.
blocks.zh: 大多数编码研究都注重解码质量,对编码行为或编码本属性的研究有限. 在编码方面很少进行过研究,特别是在调查语音代碼器编码器属性时试图在编码码簿中找到相关内容时. 其他 [10], [11] 使用后图法,试图在发现手机的概率和密码本之间找到对应. 据我们所知,没有在Prosotic领域进行系统调查。

blocks.en: The rest of the paper is organized as follows: Section 2 presents the main studies on Neural Audio Codecs. Section 3 explains how we have analyzed the Mimi codebooks. Section 4 presents our results, Section 5 discusses them and Section 6 suggests future research and concludes.
blocks.zh: 论文的其余部分编排如下: 第2节介绍关于神经音频编码的主要研究. 第三节解释了我们是如何分析米米密码本的. 第4节介绍我们的成果,第5节讨论这些成果,第6节建议今后进行研究并得出结论。

blocks.en: 2 Previous Research
blocks.zh: 2 以往的研究

blocks.en: 2.1 The multiplication of codecs
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 解码器的乘法

blocks.en:
Research of phonetic features in codecs is still an emergent field compared to a more established literature on the probing of phonetic representation in speech models like Wav2vec [ 12 ] or Whisper [ 13 , 14 ] . [ 15 ] analyzed tokens from four self-supervised learning models (HuBERT, ContentVec, data2vec, emotion2vec) manipulating prosody and speaker identity from the TIMIT corpus [ 16 ] to observe their sensitivity to prosody.
Recently, [ 17 ] focused on discrete acoustic codec space analysis, still emphasizing speech reconstruction quality. They analyze audio restoration in clean and noisy conditions and compare various codecs. They present their own codec (Language-codec), devised using a Masked Channel Residual Vector Quantization (MCRVQ) mechanism to limit what is learnt on the first three channels (codebooks) 2 2 2 In the literature that ”codebook” refers to the successions of tokens produced when encoding the sound file, and to the inventory of the tokens (in our case, from 0 to 2,047) assigned through the RQV process to a corresponding frame of the acoustic space. and adds a fourth codebook using Short-Time Fourier Transform.
blocks.zh:
与Wav2vec[12]或Whisper[13,14]等语音模型中语音表达的探究比较,对解码器中的语音特征的研究仍是一个新兴领域. [15]分析了四个自我监督的学习模型(HuBERT,ContentVec,data2vec,情感2vec)的代词,操纵TIMIT教程中的音标和扬声器身份[16],以观察其对音标的敏感性.
最近,[17]专注于离散的声学编码空间分析,仍然强调语音重建的质量. 他们在干净和吵闹的条件下分析音频修复,并比较各种解码器. 它们提出自己的编码器(Language-codec),设计时使用Masked通道残留矢量量化(MCRVQ)机制,以限制在前三个通道(codebook)2 2上学到的东西. 2个 在"编码本"的文献中,是指音效文件编码时产生的代号的继承,以及通过RQV过程分配给相应音效空间框架的代号(就我们而言,从0到2,047)的目录. 并使用短时间Fourier Transform(英语:Fourier Transform)添加了第四个代码簿.

blocks.en: [ 18 ] employed a masked encoder [ 19 ] to investigate pitch representations in NACs. They visualized encoder internal representations with t-SNE, examining pitch feature encoding and layer organization. For voice conversion and prosody manipulation, [ 20 ] developed a prosody-aware audio codec encoder (PACE). The model explicitly conditions encoding on prosodic features, enabling fine control in speech synthesis or modification.
blocks.zh: [18] 使用一个蒙面编码器 [19] 来调查 NACs的投球表示. 他们用T-SNE来视觉化编码器内部表示,检查投球特征编码和层层组织. 为了语音转换和prosody操控,[20]开发了一个prosody-aware音频编码器(PACE). 该模型明确设定了prosodic特征的编码条件,使得在语音合成或修改中能够进行精细控制.

blocks.en: 2.2 Probing codec representations
blocks.zh: 2.2 探测编码说明

blocks.en: Most neural audio codec analyses focus on decoding [ 21 ] , [ 22 ] , using mean opinion score (MOS) to mimic human speech quality judgments. MOS is the standard benchmark for evaluating codec speech reconstruction quality. Human ratings typically range from 1 (bad) to 5 (excellent) and assess reconstructed .wav quality, while automatic speech prediction systems [ 23 ] emerge for codec benchmarking. Another decoding quality metric is word error rate, measured from reconstructed signals used in speech recognition [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 多数神经音频编码分析侧重于解码[21],[22],使用平均值评分(MOS)模仿人类语音质量判断. MOS是评价编码语音重建质量的标准基准. 人类的评分一般在1(差)至5(优秀)之间,并评估重建后的.wav质量,而自动语音预测系统则出现为编码基准. 另一种解码质量度量是词错误率,根据语音识别中使用的重建信号测量. [24].

blocks.en: In contrast, encoding-focused studies often align codec codebooks to phoneme-like units via ABX methodology [ 25 ] , testing minimal pair discrimination. Another approach uses segmental realization with datasets like TIMIT to study encoder and speech decoder performance. For example, posteriogram techniques [ 26 ] estimate what was in the signal and how it could correspond to individual tokens of the codebook. This enables calculation of metrics emphasizing the frequency of codebook token usage matched to segmental units. However, systematic analyses relating to acoustic tokens and their corresponding values remain limited. To address this, benchmarks such as AnCoGen [ 19 ] have been proposed to provide comprehensive evaluations, incorporating supra-segmental features alongside segmental ones. These frameworks capture and analyze prosodic correlates within encoded speech representations.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,以编码为重点的研究往往通过ABX方法将编码码本与类似手机的单元相配合[25],测试最小对数区分. 另一种方法使用带有TIMIT等数据集的分区实现来研究编码器和语音解码器的性能. 例如,后图技术[26]估计了信号中的内容,以及它如何与代码簿的单个符号对应. 这使得能够计算强调代码簿符号使用频率的度量衡与分区单位匹配。 然而,对声标及其相应价值的系统分析仍然有限。 为了解决这一问题,提出了诸如AnCoGen[19]等基准,以提供全面评价,将超部分特征与分部分特征结合起来。 这些框架捕捉并分析了编码语音表述中的亲和性。

blocks.en: A downside is that acoustic property studies often coincide with new codecs (e.g., FlexiCodec [ 27 ] , Language-Codec [ 17 ] ), making it harder to maintain a consistent analysis. For example, [ 28 ] proposed an audio codec toolkit to facilitate research but also produced their HiFi-Codec. Research on phonetic correlates has mostly focused on segmental features to the detriment of prosodic features, and, to the best of our knowledge, no canonical correlation analysis has been proposed for codecs to investigate prosodic correlates.
blocks.zh: 一个缺点是声学属性研究往往与新的解码器(如FlexiCodec [27],Language-Codec [17])同时进行,因此更难保持一致的分析. 例如,[28]提议了一个音频编码工具包,以便利研究,但也制作了其HiFi-Codec. 有关语音关联的研究主要侧重于片段特征,而不利于prosotic特征,而且,就我们所知,没有提出对编码器进行犬科关联分析以调查prosotic关联。

blocks.en: 2.3 Residual Vector Quantization and Semantic Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.3 残余矢量定量和语义分裂

blocks.en: Most recent codecs resort to Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ), which is a hierarchical compression technique used by neural audio codecs such as Mimi. RVQ quantizes residual speech signals across multiple sequential layers of codebooks, each layer encoding information not captured by the preceding layers [ 29 ] . This layered architecture produces a discrete representation that includes both segmental phonetic details and higher-level acoustic and semantic features. Semantic distillation denotes the hypothesis that the composite representation derived from RVQ codebooks implicitly encodes semantic and suprasegmental speech aspects.
blocks.zh: 近代的解码器采用残存矢量量法(RVQ),这是咪咪等神经音频解码器使用的一种分级压缩技术. RVQ将剩余语音信号量化,跨越多个顺序的代码簿层,每层编码信息不被前层所捕获[29]. 这种分层结构产生了一种离散的表示,既包括片段的语音细节,也包括更高层次的声学和语义特征. 语义衍射表示一种假设,即从RVQ编码本中衍生出来的复合表示含蓄地编码语义和超格语音方面.

blocks.en: 3 Material and methods
blocks.zh: 3. 材料和方法

blocks.en: In our experiments, we aim to identify which aspects of the speech signal are encoded by the Mimi neural audio codec’s codebooks. The main research question we aim to answer is: are the speech correlates more segmental or suprasegmental?
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们的目标是确定语音信号的哪些方面是由Mimi神经元的密码本编码的。 我们所要回答的主要研究问题是:演讲是分门别类的还是超分门别类的?

blocks.en: 3.1 Methods
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 方法

blocks.en: Mimi is described as producing one “semantic” codebook (codebook_0), while the remainder of codebooks are ”acoustic” tokens. Our study evaluates this hypothesis with two experiments, first by correlating codebook embeddings with prosodic features (pitch, duration, glissando) and second with posteriorgram phone predictions. We performed a Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) for the prosodic features as well as a classification task to see if we can predict the correlates of speech with the codebook token values.
blocks.zh: Mimi被描述为一个“语义”编码本(codebook_0),而其余的编码本是“音响”符号。 我们的研究用两个实验来评价这个假说,首先通过将嵌入的密码本与prosodic特征(pitch,持续时间,glisando)联系起来来评价这个假说,其次通过后期电话预测来评价. 我们做了一个Canonical Correlation Analysis(CCA), 用于描述流派特征和分类任务, 看看我们是否能够预测语言与密码簿符号值之间的关联。

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA)
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 罐体关联分析

blocks.en: Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) was employed to investigate the relationship between the multidimensional neural codec codebooks and prosodic features derived from resynthesized speech. The goal is to evaluate if prosodic information is encoded in the neural codec’s discrete representations. CCA identifies linear combinations of variables from two datasets that are maximally correlated, allowing exploration of shared representations between acoustic features and codec embeddings [ 30 ] . Because the codebook tokens were categorical (with token IDs ranging from 1 to 2048), we resorted to kernel CCA using the R [ 31 ] package kernel [ 32 ] . We defined a Hamming kernel (which counts the proportion of matches across the codebook vectors) for the codebook categorical data, and measured the correlation with the three quantitative prosodic data (pitch, duration, glissando values).
blocks.zh: Canonical Correlation Analysis(CCA)被用于调查多维神经编码本与从再合成语音中衍生出来的prosotic特征之间的关系. 目的是评价神经编码器的离散表示是否编码了prosodic信息. CCA从两个数据集中识别出最大关联的变量的线性组合,可以探索声学特征与编码嵌入之间的共享表达[30]. 因为代码簿的符号是绝对的(符号ID从1到2048),所以我们使用R[31]包内核[32]使用内核CCA. 我们定义了编码本绝对数据的汉明内核(它计算了整个编码本矢量的匹配比例),并测量了与三个定量的亲和数据(pitch,持续时间,glissando值)的相关性.

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Testing Mimi Representations
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 测试Mimi的表述

blocks.en: Previous work [ 1 ] , investigating the Mimi neural audio codec’s encoder, have primarily employed the XAB perceptual method to analyze its phonetic correlates. We have reasons to believe that this method fails to capture the semantic codebook. Mimi produces a token every 80 milliseconds, which may be about the segment or below the segment for long vowels. We would rather hypothesize that the different token IDs for the semantic codebook representation are more likely to correspond to a hybrid combination of monophones, diphones, triphones, and even quadphones. Our motivation for including these phonetic and suprasegmental correlates in our analysis arises from the hypothesis that Mimi’s codebook tokens may also encode connected speech processes. These may include phenomena such as assimilations or persistent repetitive segments, which are characteristic of natural fluent speech.
blocks.zh: 先前的作品[1], 调查Mimi神经音频编码器, 我们有理由相信这种方法无法捕捉到语义编码本. 米米每80毫秒产生一个令牌,可能约于段或段以下,用于长元音. 我们宁可假设 语义编码书代表的不同代号 更可能与单声道、双声道、双声道甚至四声道的混合组合对应 我们将这些口头和超部分相关内容纳入分析的动机来自一种假设,即Mimi的密码簿符号也可能编码相连的语音程序。 这些现象可能包括同化或持久性重复部分等自然流利言论的特征。

blocks.en: We analyze the capability of codebooks to capture segmental representations by comparing phone predictions derived from posteriorgrams [ 26 ] with the discrete tokens generated by the Mimi codec, and we try to investigate whether the sequence of the eight codebooks can be correlated to the phone prediction obtained by the posteriorgrams (which are the generation of posterior probabilities of the phonetic categories). We aligned the posteriorgram predictions (the phone predicted with the highest probability, one every 20ms) to each time frame corresponding to a Mimi codebook (80ms) for the 6300 files of the TIMIT data. We excluded the NA and [PAD] values, resulting in a dataset of 52,749 Mimi tokens with their four corresponding posteriorgram predictions. The Mimi codec allows for 8, or 32 codebooks. We focused on the 8 version but also computed results for the 32 codebook version for our systematic investigation of the prosodic features and of the segmental features.
blocks.zh: 我们通过将后传的电话预测与米米编码生成的离散符号相比较来分析代码本捕捉分块表示的能力,我们试图调查八本代码的序列能否与后传获得的电话预测相关联(即产生语音类的后传概率). 我们把后方的预测(以最高概率预测的电话,每20ms)与每时段对应的Mimi编码本(80ms),用于TIMIT数据的6300文件. 我们排除了NA和[PAD]的值,结果得出了52,749个米米符号及其四个相应的后图预测的数据集. 米米编码器允许8或32个代码本. 我们重点研究了8版,但也计算了32版编码本的结果,以系统调查prosodic特征和分区特征。

blocks.en: 3.1.3 Classification Task
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 分类任务

blocks.en: We used the Tilburg memory-based learner (TiMBL) that implements the k-nn algorithm for categorical values as predictors [ 33 ] to analyze whether we could predict our three prosodic features or the posteriorgram phone labels with the codebook token values. TiMBL operates by storing labeled instances and classifying new data points based on the majority class among their k closest neighbors in the feature space, where closeness is typically measured by a distance metric. In our study, TiMBL is applied to classify tokens generated by the Mimi codec to assess how well discrete codebook embeddings can represent phonetic and prosodic classes. To be more specific, we only analyzed the tokens of the codebooks that corresponded to the synthetically modified syllable. In 75% of the cases (the longest files), the last five tokens corresponded to the final silence and the eight previous tokens matched the representation of the modified syllables. For the prosodic predictions, we used TiMBL with 64 features, corresponding to eight tokens multiplied by eight codebooks.
blocks.zh: 我们使用蒂尔堡基于记忆的学习器(TimbL),将绝对值的k-nn算法作为预测器执行 [33] 来分析我们是否可以预测我们三个Prosodic 特性,或者用密码簿符号值的后置电话标签. TiMBL的操作方式是存储标注实例,并根据在特征空间中其k最接近的邻邻中的多数类对新数据点进行分类,其中的近似度通常用距离度量来测量. 在我们的研究中,TiMBL被用于对Mimi编码器生成的符号进行分类,以评估离散的编码本嵌入法如何能代表语音类和prosodic类. 更具体地说,我们只分析了与合成修改的音节对应的编码本的符号. 在75%的案件(最长的档案)中,最后5个符号对应的是最终的沉默,之前的8个符号对应了修改后的音节的代表. 对于Prosotic的预测,我们使用了带有64个特征的TimBL,对应8个符号乘以8个代码本.

blocks.en: 3.2 Data
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据

blocks.en: For the investigation of segmental correlates, we replicate the codec analysis proposed by the analysis of the SpeechTokenizer codec [ 24 ] using the TIMIT dataset. The TIMIT dataset consists of broadband recordings from 630 speakers of eight major American English dialects, each reading ten phonetically rich sentences with time-aligned transcriptions [ 16 ] . We probed the posteriorgram correspondence between the phone predicted by posteriorgram generation with a system trained on the TIMIT datasets [ 26 ] and the Mimi codebooks that were generated using the TIMIT data.
blocks.zh: 为了调查分块关联,我们复制了SpeechTokenizer编码器分析中提议的使用TIMIT数据集的编码分析. TIMIT数据集由来自美国八大英语方言的630位演讲者的宽带录音组成,每集读十句带有时态的丰富的句子[16]. 我们调查了后传一代所预测的电话与利用TIMIT数据生成的TIMIT数据集[26]培训的系统之间的后传通信.

blocks.en: For the investigation of prosodic correlates, we utilized a synthetic dataset created using the WinPitch software [ 9 ] . We controlled for pitch, duration, and glissando for the modification of the last syllable of the sentence “He arrived on time”. We systematically modified the pitch (+10Hz), duration (+10ms), and glissando values in regular increments, allowing for the following variations to be observed. We generated the sentences with a value of pitch ranging from 100 to 490 Hz and the duration of the last syllable range from 10 to 390 milliseconds. 1029 variants of prosodic events in total were analyzed and compared to the eight vectors of the corresponding Mimi codebooks.
blocks.zh: 为了调查prosodic关联,我们使用了使用WinPitch软件创建的合成数据集[9]. 我们控制了投球、持续时间和格利桑多,以修改“他准时到达”这一句的最后一个音节。 我们系统地修改了投球(+10Hz),持续时间(+10ms),以及常规增量中的格利桑多值,从而可以观察到以下变化. 我们生成的句子值为100至490赫兹,最后一个音节的长度为10至390毫秒. 总共对1029种prosodic事件的变体进行了分析,并与对应的米米密码本的8种向量进行了比较.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Artificial generation of speech with codebook token IDs
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 人工生成带有密码簿代号的语音

blocks.en: The Mimi codebook generates sequences of tokens on eight codebooks (or more), which are the representations of the speech signal. We also tested the potential correlates of the Mimi token codebooks by artificially generating codebook vectors with arbitrary token IDs values.
blocks.zh: 米米编码本在8个编码本(或更多)上生成符号序列,即语音信号的表示. 我们还通过人工生成带有任意的代号ID值的代号向量,测试了米米符号编码簿的潜在关联性.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Mixed results
blocks.zh: 4.1 混合结果

blocks.en: For our CCA analysis, about 25% of shared variance ( ≈ \approx 0.498² = 0.248) is captured by the first canonical dimension. We did not resort to Wilks test as it would be just an approximation since we are using a kernel method (kernel-based similarity, not raw numeric data). We then ran a classification task to realize that the eight codebooks were rather poor predictors of pitch (and subsequently, glissando) (see Table 1 ) but better predictors of the phone labels predicted by the posteriorgram method. For the phone predictions, the tokens have been realigned to the corresponding time stamps, so that eight tokens from eight codebooks are used as predictors.
blocks.zh: 在我们的CCA分析中,大约25%的共享差异(\\\\ 大约0.4982=0.248)被第一峡谷维度捕获. 我们没有使用Wilks测试,因为它只是一个近似值,因为我们使用了内核方法(基于内核的相似性,而不是原始的数字数据). 然后我们做了一个分类任务来意识到这八本密码本是相当差的投球预测器(以及后来的glissando)(见表1),但更能预测后期方法预言的电话标签. 对于电话预测,信使被重新调整为相应的时间邮票,因此8个密码本中的8个信使被用作预测器.

blocks.en: Table 1: TiMBL prediction performance (with K=5) for the 8 tokens of the 8 codebooks for our three prosodic variables and phone predictions with the aligned token for the TIMIT data
blocks.zh: 表1:针对8个编码本中的8个符号的TimBL预测性能(含K=5),用于我们三个Prosodic变量和电话预测,与TIMIT数据中的对齐符号

blocks.en: We evaluated how Mimi encodes three prosodic parameters manipulated in the synthesized corpus: duration, pitch, and glissando. For each parameter, TiMBL was used with Leave-One-Out testing, k = 5 k=5 , Overlap metric and GainRatio weighting.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了Mimi如何编码了 合成体中被操纵的3个Prosodic参数:持续时间、投球和glisando。 对于每个参数,TiMBL被用于Leave-One-Out测试,k=5 k=5,重叠度量衡和GainRatio加权.

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Prosodic variables
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 平均变量

blocks.en:
Duration classification reached 92.3% accuracy.
This indicates that Mimi’s tokenization preserves duration noticeably well.
GainRatio showed that the most predictive features were concentrated in the codebooks_1-3.
Pitch classification yielded 15.5% accuracy.
Although much lower than the duration, the performance is above chance (given the number of classes to predict), demonstrating that pitch information is partially recoverable from the tokens.
The highest GainRatio values again came from codebooks_0–3.
blocks.zh:
时间分类准确度达到92.3%。
这表明,Mimi的象征性表现很好地保持了持续时间。
GainRatio显示,最预测性的特征集中在代码簿_1-3.
得出小品分类 15.5%的准确度.
虽然远低于持续时间,但性能高于偶然性(考虑到需要预测的类数),表明投球信息可以从符号中部分回收.
最高的GainRatio值再次来自代码簿_0–3.

blocks.en: Glissando classification reached 8.1% accuracy. Despite the fine-grained target space, glissando direction and slope were recoverable above chance. As with pitch, the strongest predictors were found in codebooks_1-3. The last two tokens in each codebook were consistently the most predictive across all prosodic variables.
blocks.zh: 格利桑多分类达到8.1%的精确度. 尽管目标空间布局精细,但Glissando方向和坡度是可以比机会更恢复的。 和投球一样,最强的预测器在代码簿_1-3. 每个编码簿中的最后两个符号始终是对所有Prosotic变量最具有预测性的。

blocks.en: 4.2 Number of Codebooks
blocks.zh: 4.2 法典数量

blocks.en: We tested two types of implementations, the 8-codebook and the 32-codebook, the hypothesis being that with the 8-codebook version we would have a better way to predict the correlates of the system and that the 8-codebook version was more likely to predict the prosodic features that we tested. The first 8 codebooks were identical in the 8 and the 32 version.
blocks.zh: 我们测试了两种类型的执行,即8码本和32码本,假设是,有了8码本版本,我们就有更好的方法来预测系统的关联性,8码本版本更可能预测我们测试的流派特征. 前8本编码本在8本和32本相同.

blocks.en: 4.3 Semantic Leakage
blocks.zh: 4.3 语义泄漏

blocks.en: Using the information gain ratio as a criterion in the classification task using TiMBL, we observed that the feature importance of the different codebooks varied systematically for all the predictions. An important observation, which perhaps mirrors RQV is the number of unique tokens grows with each new codebook. The number of unique tokens in codebook_0 is potentially consistent with allophone representations of the syllable ”time”, but tokens in the codebook_0 fail to predict the phone labels as accurately as the 8 codebooks taken together, so that some form of the semantic leakage might be at work over the other seven codebooks (see Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 利用信息增益比作为使用TimBL进行分类任务的标准,我们观察到,不同编码本的特征重要性对于所有预测都是有计划的. 一个重要的观察,也许可以反射RQV,就是每个新密码本所生长的独特符号的数量. 代码簿_0中独有的符号数量可能与音节"时间"的Allophone表示一致,但代码簿_0中的符号未能像8个代码簿一起准确预测电话标签,因此某种语义渗漏可能在其他7个代码簿上起作用(见表2).

blocks.en: Table 2: Number of unique token IDs per codebook
blocks.zh: 表2:每个代码簿中唯一代号ID的数量

blocks.en: 4.4 Segmental Correlates
blocks.zh: 4.4 分层关联

blocks.en:
Partially replicating the SpeechTokenizer experiments matching codebook IDs with posteriorgrams, we managed to match codebook IDs to posteriogram predictions. We surmise that the representation in tokens, which spans over 80 milliseconds may correspond to quadphones, triphones, diphones, and single phone representations for the 2048 token IDs of codebook_0.
On the TIMIT dataset, for the 80 ms time frames corresponding to the 52,749 tokens produced in codebook_0, we observed 33,540 realisations of identical posteriogram predictions (possibly phones), 18,795 realisations of two different posteriogram predictions (possibly diphones), 413 realisations of three different posteriogram predictions (possibly triphones) and one candidate for quadphone (the plausible frequent phone sequence /InD@/, corresponding to tokenID 1047).
blocks.zh:
部分复制了SpeechTokenizer的实验,将代码表ID与后图匹配,我们设法将代码表ID与后图预测匹配. 我们推测,超过80毫秒的代币表示可能与密码簿_0的2048个代币ID的四合机,三合机,二合机和单机表示相对应.
在TIMIT数据集中,我们观测到与编码簿_0中制作的52,749个信使相对应的80毫秒时间范围,33,540个相同的后图预测(可能为手机)实现,18,795个不同后图预测(可能为双手机)实现,413个不同后图预测(可能为双手机)实现,1个四手机候选人(可能为常见电话序列/InD@/,对应代号ID1047)。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Gender bias or specialization?
blocks.zh: 5.1 性别偏见或专业化?

blocks.en: Figure 1: Gender prominence in the Mimi tokens (TIMIT data)
blocks.zh: 图 1: 米米信物中的性别突出(TIMIT数据)

blocks.en: Table 3: Statistics of codebook tokens and exclusivity rate.
blocks.zh: 表3:密码簿符号和专属率统计。

blocks.en: The 2,048 tokens used in each codebook may represent distinct acoustic features for each codebook. When looking at codebook specific tokens, the one with the most exclusivity per gender is by far codebook_1. For instance, no female has token_ID 6 in codebook_1, which makes it gender exclusive for this codebook, but we see token_ID 6 in female data elsewhere. It is also interesting to note that codebook_1 has far fewer unique tokens than other codebooks. When looking at unique token (independent from the codebook they are from), a few tokens show a gender bias (none are exclusive, though).
blocks.zh: 每个代码本中使用的2,048个符号可能代表每个代码本的鲜明的声学特征. 在查看代码簿特定符号时,每个性别排他性最强的符号是代码簿_1. 例如,在编码簿_1中,女性没有符号_ID 6,这使得该编码簿的性别独占,但我们在其他地方的女性数据中可以看到符号_ID 6。 还值得注意的是,编码本_1独有的代号远少于其他编码本. 在查看独特的符号(独立于它们来自的代码簿)时,少数符号显示出性别偏见(虽然没有一种是排他性的).

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablation experiments and synthetic codebook values
blocks.zh: 5.2 校验实验和合成密码簿值

blocks.en:
To test the meaning of the first codebook, we performed a perceptual ablation experiment replacing the first codebook token values by arbitrary numbers between 1 and 100 and the sound file was audibly very similar to the original sound file, so that we may conclude that the first codebook is surprisingly not as important as the combination of all the codebooks taken together.
When multiple 8 codebooks were simultaneously modified with synthetic or cycled values, the speech degradation was noticeable, characterized by noise and unintelligible words. This suggests that the speech decoder relies heavily on joint coherence across multiple codebooks to maintain naturalness and clarity.
blocks.zh:
为了测试第一个编码本的意义,我们进行了一个感知性减值实验,用1到100之间的任意数字来取代第一个编码本符号值,声音文件显然与原声文件非常相似,因此我们可以得出结论,第一个编码本并不象所有编码本组合在一起那么重要.
当多个8个代码本同时被合成值或循环值修改时,语音退化是显著的,其特点是噪音和不通晓的词. 这表明语音解码器严重依赖多个代码本之间的联合一致性来保持自然性和清晰性.

blocks.en: 5.3 Specialization or Distributed semantics?
blocks.zh: 5.3 专业化还是分布式语义学?

blocks.en: An alternative experiment is the resynthesis of the codebooks with the assumption that if the codebooks have specific meanings or prosodic values associated to the tokens, we would be expected to observe variability in frequency, pitch or glissando investigating the output from codebooks synthetically generated using artificial numbers from zero to 2,048. The sequences are somehow arbitrary. We suspect that there is a form of solidarity for the eight values of the codebook, so that we also tested on a minimal number of token units that we found in the data the change that we observed modifying these token ideas.
blocks.zh: 另一种实验是密码本的再合成,假设如果密码本具有与符号相关的具体含义或正值,我们可望在频率,投球或格利桑多观测到利用人工数字从0到2,048合成的密码本的输出. 顺序有点武断 我们怀疑对代码本的8个值有某种团结形式,因此我们也在数据中发现的最小的符号单位中测试了我们观察到的修改这些符号概念的变化.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we have shown that the division of labour for the Mimi codec between the semantic codebook and the acoustic codebooks might not be as clear-cut as initially posited [ 1 ] . The so-called ‘acoustic codebooks’ (from codebook_1 to codebook_7) correlate strongly with duration, but not with glissando and pitch values. It might be the case that tokens are good predictors of duration because, mechanically, as duration increases, tokens are produced every 80 ms. However, clearer correlations can be established with the codebook_0 values with phone, diphone, triphone and quadphone representations than suggested in the ABX discrimination method [ 34 , 1 ] . Future neural audio codecs may benefit from a more specialized allocation of representational capacity, where different vectors are optimized for distinct prosodic dimensions. This could pave the way for better prosodic controllability in synthesis and robustness in speech models.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们已经表明,在语义编码书和声学编码书之间对米米码的分工可能不如最初假定的[1]那么明确. 所谓的 " 声学密码本 " (从密码本_1到密码本_7)与持续时间密切相关,但与格利桑多和投球值无关。 可能情况是,象征物是持续时间的好预测,因为机械上,随着持续时间的增加,象征物每80毫秒产生一次. 然而,与ABX歧视方法[34,1]中的建议相比,可以建立更明确的与有电话,双声道,triphone和四声道表示的代码簿_0值的关联. 未来的神经音频编解码器可能得益于更专业化的表达能力分配,其中不同的矢量被优化,用于不同的正极维度. 这可以为改进合成的Prosodic可控性和语音模型的稳健性铺平道路。
